title: IA Model
description: The single source of truth for app-wide navigation: LeftNav groups, TopNav role config per layout, footer identity, modal coupling rules. Produced by a Beat 1 agent from the PRD's persona + user stories; consumed by `scaffold-chrome` to emit src/components/app/{AppLeftNav,AppTopNav,AppScreen}.tsx.

brand.description: Product/app name shown in the LeftNav and TopNav. Derived from the PRD product name. Required for branded prototypes; if omitted, scaffold-chrome defaults to 'App'.

leftNav.description: LeftNav groups rendered on every route. Items appear in array order.

topNavRoles.description: TopNav composition per layout role. Keys are the role names referenced by AppScreen's `role` prop.

center.description: Which slot AppTopNav fills in the center: page title, breadcrumb crumbs, or empty

modalPattern.description: Rules for modal routes that overlay an underlying screen.

backdropMustImport.description: If true, modal routes import the underlying screen as their backdrop via a shared component (no independent backdrop authoring).

footer.description: User identity rendered in the LeftNav footer.

stubByDesign.description: Routes the IA explicitly allows to render only a stub EmptyState. Default is empty: every routable surface must have authored content.
